title: Rent Receipt Template
description: Free monthly rent receipt template for India with tenant, landlord, rent period, payment mode, landlord PAN and a revenue stamp box, ready for HRA claims. Use it in Word, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Excel or Overleaf.
features: Landlord PAN and revenue stamp box for HRA claims
Rent period, amount in words and payment mode
One A4 page with tenant and landlord signature lines
useCases: Tenant and landlord proof of payment

items: Property: [Flat / House No., Building, Street, City, State, PIN]

blocks.text: Amount in words: **[Rupees Fifteen Thousand Only]**
Landlord PAN is required for HRA claims when the yearly rent is more than ₹1,00,000. Affix a revenue stamp if the rent is paid in cash and exceeds ₹5,000.
